name: Delicious Pain
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+) You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Toughened Flesh.description: Immediately after you take Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
